method.why_this_section_exists: E025 fixed the measure but left four execution details unstated: which hours (the first 500, or all on the day), the bootstrap seed, how an hour without an outcome is handled, and where the result is written. They are fixed here by the project's existing conventions, in a commit made before any outcome is read, so none of them can be chosen after seeing an answer.
method.hours: Exactly the FIRST 500 usable news hours in time order: a fixed prefix, as research/LIVE_EVALUATION.md rule 8 does for the move-size checkpoints. Reading 'whenever it looks good' would be optional stopping. Usable = pipeline 0.2.0, no run_meta.news_error, and a news category score with weight > 0, which is E025's own query (agent/research/news_power.NEWS_SQL). The weekly report's counter selects the identical 571 hours (checked 2026-10-14 from the news score only). The prefix runs 2026-09-19 20:00 -> 2026-10-11 13:00 UTC. Later hours are never used for this look.
method.news_score: the hour's stored news category score, the value live scoring used, unchanged
method.returns: prediction_outcomes.pct_change_from_prediction (a fraction) at horizon 1 (primary) and 6 and 24 (descriptive): reference close to the close of the candle opening at as_of + H, status 'ok' only. An hour in the prefix without an 'ok' outcome at a horizon is left out at that horizon, and the count is reported.
method.interval: 95% percentile interval of a 48h circular block bootstrap, 500 resamples, seed 17, over the hours in time order: agent.research.metrics.block_bootstrap, the checkpoint's own function and seed (agent/research/live_checkpoint.py)
method.reported_with: n per horizon, the news score's mean and sd in the window, E025's minimum detectable rho at 500 hours (0.125 at 1h, 0.274 at 6h, 0.416 at 24h; 80% power), and the interval's measured false-positive rate at 500 hours (about 9% instead of 5%)
method.written_once: research/results/E030/news_first_look.md and .json; the script refuses to overwrite them

what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.any_result: Descriptive only, NO verdict, at every horizon. The registered verdict needs 3,140 usable hours (E025).
what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.interval_excludes_zero_at_1h: Not evidence of an effect. At 500 hours the interval is liberal (about 9% false positives under no effect), and only |rho| >= 0.125 is detectable, far above anything this programme has found (|rho| 0.05-0.08). So the likelier readings are a false positive or an over-estimate. Recorded; the verdict waits.
what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.interval_includes_zero_at_1h: Not evidence of no effect. At this size the test cannot see the plausible effect (|rho| 0.05). Recorded; the verdict waits.

result: 1h (primary): rho +0.046 [-0.052, +0.151]; 6h: +0.001 [-0.200, +0.210]; 24h: -0.096 [-0.380, +0.209]. Every interval includes zero. By the reading fixed in advance this is NOT evidence of no effect: at 500 hours only |rho| >= 0.125 is detectable at 1h, and a plausible effect (|rho| 0.05) is not. The 1h point estimate sits at that plausible size, with an interval about six times wider than it. No verdict; the registered verdict needs 3,140 usable hours. Nothing changed.
side_observations_descriptive: The news score is less positive than E025's first 97 hours suggested: mean +0.101 (E025: +0.224), 138 of 500 hours negative (E025: 5 of 97). Descriptive; nothing is read into it.
